generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with edit-target.png first and L2-seed-region-r2-source.png second as reference only

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: The exact repository rock-lighting formula clears the measured gate, but the literal one-flat-value rule is not met by inspection: many bench and altar tops remain lighter than their vertical faces.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median width across 29 isolated tall dark-green crown-core components after a one-pixel opening and geometry filters; scaled by 2560/1254. The threshold omits lighter branch tips, so this is conservative, but the diagnostic overlay and direct inspection both show many complete crowns below the required 41 source-pixel floor.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: Broad plateau and altar-adjacent shelf tops count as buildable; exposed bench, altar, and tarn-bowl faces count as steep; scree, broken moor, boulders, cracks, and conifer groups make up the remainder.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Connected hue-based classification of the source raster's painted teal and green-teal tarn pixels, constrained to the tarn search region, followed by local raster closure, 139 enclosed classifier gaps filled, and a two-source-pixel wet-fringe expansion. The boundary follows painted pixels, not a polyline.

source_scale_gate_proxy.classifier: repository saturated blue-dominant fringe predicate applied outside the delivered binary mask
source_scale_gate_proxy.note: Node is absent from this managed shell; the source-radius reproduction uses the same fringe predicate and scale-equivalent radii.

open_risks: The measured rejection condition is corrected numerically: rock lighting is 0.072 on 93,410 strong rock edges against the 0.15 limit. This does not satisfy the separate literal visual rule; bright tops over darker faces remain visible.
Hard geology failure: multiple bench edges are long regular runs of similar columns with square or near-square turns, rather than wandering weathered formations with broken buttresses and gaps.
Hard altar failure: the raised formation left of the tarn reads as a deliberately arranged circular or stepped column platform, not reliably as a weather-made natural altar.
Hard scale failure: the conservative crown-core median is about 51.0 px / 2.45 m at final scale, and numerous full visible crowns remain below the required 84 px / 4 m floor.
The local 6 px and 48 px water-fringe proxies pass, but the official Node authoring gate was unavailable in this managed shell.
Seam continuity, exact wet-pixel boundary judgment, geology naturalism, and overall visual quality remain director and owner decisions; this report makes no visual acceptance claim.
